posts.text:
Hello! Quill is a free EPUB reader for Android, with Aira, a reading companion that answers questions about your book without spoiling what's ahead.

Get it on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.yugentech.quill
posts.alt: Quill, your AI reading companion. A phone shows the book page for Sylvie and Bruno by Lewis Carroll, with Read and Shelf buttons, the chapter list and an Aira button in the corner.
